title: feat(nmt2sy): M two-tick composition on #7211: reverse HOLD, face HOLD, composition HOLD
science: The same two-tick comparison on the four #7211 y-probes of the y-symmetric three-site process: M is unchanged from t to t+1, reverse and face HOLD at both cuts, composition HOLDs.
